chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: The third wife, English-Mexican, and the end of that marriage
summary: He brought a woman from England to Germany then America; she wanted to go out at night and divorced him around 1964-65.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I found somebody else I liked when I came back and I spent all the time trying to get them to come to America and I finally got them to America and then when I got them to America was hanging out with some friends and she wanted to come in at 12 o'clock at night and go out with Tom, Dick or Harry wherever they wanted to go. I didn't know she was the kind of person she was until after I got her away from England. She was from England. I got her from England to Germany and I found out she wasn't the kind of person -- and she wanted to divorce me. So I says, go ahead.
second wife or your third wife?
First white wife, yeah, yes and she was so mixed blooded that I didn't know what she was going to do. Anyway, she was Mexican, English/Mexican descent.
